reporting-org.narrative: FMO NV (Nederlandse Financierings-Maatschappij voor Ontwikkelingslanden N.V.)

description.narrative: FMO will invest US$5 mln in Class B equity, and due to the fund's 50/50 debt/equity structure, FMO's equity will catalyze US$5 mln in debt from other investors. The transaction will reach a large number of smallholders by providing finance to producer organizations (cooperatives). The initial focus of the fund is on Latin America and the Caribbean, one of the main Fairtrade markets, with later expansion to Africa and Asia.
